name: ibis Melaka
short_description: A 249-room hotel on Jalan Bendahara inside Melaka's UNESCO World Heritage Site, walking distance to Christ Church, Dutch Square, and Jonker Street.
ai_summary: ibis Melaka sits on Jalan Bendahara within Melaka's UNESCO World Heritage-listed historic center, a stroll from Christ Church, Dutch Square, A Famosa Fort, Cheng Hoon Teng Temple, and Jonker Street. The 249 contemporary rooms feature the brand's Sweet Bed by ibis, and the hotel offers a swimming pool, fitness center, three function rooms and two halls, and the ibis Kitchen restaurant with an all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet of local and international dishes. Guests consistently value the heritage-district walkability and straightforward, reliable ibis-brand comfort.

pros: 249 rooms within Melaka's UNESCO World Heritage Site
Walking distance to Christ Church, Dutch Square, A Famosa Fort, and Jonker Street
Swimming pool, fitness center, and the Sweet Bed by ibis in every room
ibis Kitchen restaurant with an all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet

cons: As a budget-styled hotel, room sizes and finishes are more compact than upscale Melaka boutique properties
The heritage-district setting can be busy with tourist foot traffic
research_highlights: The walkable heritage-district location is called highly convenient
The breakfast buffet's local and international variety draws consistent praise
Room comfort, including the Sweet Bed by ibis, is repeatedly highlighted
research_watchouts: No significant recurring watchouts surfaced across recent reviews

faqs.question: Is ibis Melaka within walking distance of Jonker Street?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's inside Melaka's UNESCO World Heritage Site on Jalan Bendahara, a stroll from Jonker Street, Christ Church, Dutch Square, and A Famosa Fort.

faqs.question: Does ibis Melaka include breakfast?
faqs.answer: The ibis Kitchen restaurant offers an all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet with a spread of local and international dishes, available for guests to add to their stay.
